index: Consumer Price Index, all groups (June 2020 = 100), Central Statistical Office of Eswatini, as the Central Bank of Eswatini's Quarterly Review publishes it (Table S 8.1, CMA Comparative Price Indices)
note: Monthly: each year's mean is of its twelve months. The Central Statistical Office's own monthly inflation releases are on gov.sz, which resets the connection from here; the Central Bank of Eswatini prints the Office's index in each Quarterly Review's Table S 8.1 (its sources: 'Eswatini Central Statistical Office'), on the base of June 2020 = 100 that the Office adopted with new weights in June 2020. 2021's twelve months are read from the March 2022 Quarterly Review (written with decimal commas: 102,1 is 102.1); 2025's from the March 2026 Quarterly Review, which also gives October and November 2025 (the December 2025 Review's table skips them). 2021's mean (103.875) agrees with the 2021 annual figure both later Reviews give (103.9). The 2025 annual figure the Reviews print (122.4) is the mean of the ten months the December 2025 Review had, not of the twelve; the months are used. The December 2025 Review prints December 2024 as 135.63, a misprint the March 2026 Review corrects to 120.4899; neither year read here depends on it.
